title: C2P: Dissect the injected facility packet type
description:
Version 2 type 12 carries a facility layer message that was injected into
the stack, preceded by the notification metadata that the receiving
facility layer sees: the radio parameters of the packet and its security
info, including the service specific permissions.

Hand the payload over to the dissector of the message set that the
facility message type names. Only the ETSI ITS one is part of Wireshark.
The SAE J2735, IEEE 1609.3 WSA and China MessageFrame dissectors are used
when a plugin provides them, and the payload is shown as data otherwise.

Generalise cv2x_tx_power_format() into power_dbm_format() so that the
facility RSSI can reuse it. Both are a dBm power level that uses INT16_MAX
as its not available value.

Assisted-by: Claude
